notes: E-Sys MAX 2.0: a new, simpler look and easier coding. Home is your garage: your car drawn by its body type, when it was last read, and your E-Sys versions to start, all on one screen without scrolling. Three tabs: Home, Settings and About (your licence now sits in About). In the FDL editor every setting reads plainly: name, byte and bit, value. 'What can I code?' is now a checklist: tick the changes you want, press Apply once, and Undo puts them all back; two changes that would set the same setting differently are refused. Press F2 on a setting to name it, and share your names so every customer gets them. Community cheat sheets download by themselves. Fixes: a current Java 8 inside E-Sys 3.x starts, a maximised window stays on screen, and many smaller fixes.
